plays: SOXL: Consider trimming or exiting SOXL given its -51.65% loss and leveraged decay. Respect its default stop at 200 or adjust lower.
SPAL: Review SPAL's -39.28% loss. As a leveraged ETF, its decay and volatility are significant; consider its default stop at 21.38.
